notes:
- New power-up: LOCKDOWN (hammer and boards icon): every window on the map gets all its boards back
  instantly, and every player gets 200 points.
- Zombies take longer to reach the windows: they appear further out and trudge up to the window
  (about 5 s for walkers, 2-3 s for runners, roughly twice as long as before). Runners still sprint once inside.
- Runners are a bit slower (3.5-4.2 m/s early on, 4.0-4.9 from round 8; was 3.8-4.6 / 4.4-5.4).
- Slower knife: 0.8 s between swings (was 0.6 s).
